meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能用 dial 命令行通过一个真实电话号码发短信、打 AI 语音电话、接收来短信与验证码；各命令均支持 --json 输出。
howto.when: 当你提到短信、电话、验证码等词，或要求发短信、打电话、等待验证码时触发；会话中首次运行 dial 命令前也会先加载。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 发条短信：明天见面改到三点。
say.note: 会用 dial message 发送这条短信。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 打个语音电话，问他明天几点到。
say.note: 用 dial call 拨打，结束后可查通话结果。

say.text: 用短信通道等一条验证码，收到后告诉我。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the dial CLI with a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts and codes; commands support --json output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention SMS, calls, or verification codes, ask to text or call someone, or wait for a code; also loads before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and ask what time he arrives tomorrow.
say_en.note: Places a dial call with an AI voice agent.

say_en.text: Wait for a verification code over SMS and tell me what it is.
